name: Risers Pizza
notes: 4 photos: 1-2 are a laminated printed menu branded 'HOBOKEN - The Original Pizza & Beer Joint', 1459 Garnet Ave, Pacific Beach; rizerspizza.com redirects to a Toast page at that same address, so this is the same location under legacy signage/branding, not a different business. 3 is a whiteboard with hours of operation and a cut-off 'Chicken Wings (10 Wings)' line, no new legible priced dishes beyond what's already captured. 4 is a chalkboard with per-slice prices (Cheese, Roni, Sici, Sici Roni, Combo Slice, Combo Sici), included as a 'Slices' section. Sizes/toppings pricing tables and modifiers (per-inch sub sizing, pizza topping add-ons) were dropped per rules; multi-size items keep all printed prices in the description since a single numeric price would misrepresent them.
